title: ADF Product of the Year 2027: Recognising the commitment of the dental industry
html:
Association Dentaire Française

Wed. 25. November 2026

share save

PARIS, France: Each edition of the Congrès de l’ADF, the annual congress of the French Dental Association (ADF), provides an opportunity to showcase innovations that address the current challenges facing the dental profession. Through the ADF Product of the Year award, the ADF recognises manufacturers and suppliers whose products are designed to advance clinical practice, enhance patient safety and improve the patient experience.

Two products will receive the 2027 ADF Product of the Year award at this year’s congress, taking place from 24 to 28 November in Paris: one in the equipment category and the other in the consumables category. Ahead of the congress, a jury of ADF representatives, journalists from the dental trade press and dental practitioners selected the ten finalist products. During the congress, visit the exhibitors’ stands to discover the ten finalist products and vote for your favourites through the ADF congress app.

The finalists in the equipment category

Doctor Smile TMI (Lambda)—KAELUX, Booth 2M28
TMI (Total Mouth Irradiation) is an innovative diode laser handpiece designed for photo-biomodulation and oral laser therapy applications. It can be used for decontamination of the oral cavity, treatment of mucositis and stimulation of tooth movement during orthodontic treatment. It also supports biological healing processes, reduces inflammation and improves patient comfort through minimally invasive clinical protocols.

MELAcare 600 (MELAG)—MELAG, Booth 1P16
The MELAcare 600 is a fully automated unit for cleaning, disinfecting and maintaining rotary instruments. Depending on the selected configuration, it can also clean and disinfect ultrasonic scaler tips.

PANDA smart (Freqty Technology)—WAM, Booth 1L02
The PANDA smart is a next-generation intra-oral scanner designed for dental practices looking to integrate digital workflows without compromising on performance or budget. Compatible with leading dental CAD software, including exocad, it integrates seamlessly into clinical and laboratory workflows.

Planmeca Pro50 S (Planmeca)—Planmeca, Booth 2L08
Planmeca Pro50 S is a compact, ambidextrous dental unit featuring a side-mounted delivery system with hanging-hose instruments.

IRIS by Starck (Scan4all SAS)—Biotech Dental Group, Booth 3M11
IRIS by Starck is a next-generation intra-oral camera, designed and manufactured in France, that combines high-definition imaging, artificial intelligence and photogrammetry technologies for implant dentistry. It features two 1,200 × 1,200 pixel sensors, an inertial measurement unit for real-time motion tracking and synchronised lighting to enable the acquisition of highly accurate 3D models.

The finalists in the consumables category

OptraGate Dry Control (Ivoclar)—Ivoclar, Booth 1L12
OptraGate Dry Control is a saliva ejector with an integrated tongue retractor and is designed to optimise moisture control and isolation of the treatment area.

Elmex Junior Professional MIH-Expert Protection (Colgate)—Colgate, Booth 4L10
This elmex toothpaste combines Pro-Argin technology (8% arginine and calcium carbonate) with a child-friendly flavour. It is formulated for use at home by children aged 6 years and older who have been diagnosed with molar incisor hypomineralisation, helping to protect affected teeth.

WF-26 Plus (Waterpik)—Waterpik, Booth 4L09
WF-26 Plus is a cordless water flosser that offers an effective and easy-to-use solution for daily interdental cleaning, complementing regular toothbrushing.

SILKY PURE (SATELEC)—ACTEON, Booth 1L14
SILKY PURE is an air-polishing powder designed for precise, gentle supragingival biofilm and stain removal.

JD Bone Track (JdentalCare)—JDentalCare, Stand 4LC
JD Bone Track is a patented drill kit designed to simplify immediate implant placement.
